name: Marie-France Dubois
bio:
Marie-France's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While studying mechanical engineering at McGill, a chance encounter with a local Formula Ford team ignited a passion that would shape her career. She started as a volunteer, quickly proving her aptitude for problem-solving and her dedication to optimizing performance.

Marie-France believes that a chief engineer's primary role is to foster collaboration and empower their team. She values open communication and strives to create an environment where every member feels comfortable sharing ideas and challenging assumptions. Her approach is data-driven, but she also trusts her gut feeling, honed by years of experience. What sets Marie-France apart is her ability to blend her deep technical knowledge with strong interpersonal skills, making her a valuable asset to any team looking to climb the ranks.

While relatively new to the chief engineer role, she is committed to continuous learning and growth. She is eager to apply her skills and enthusiasm to a team ready to embrace innovation and push the boundaries of performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, practical bob, often pulled back with a clip
physical.description: A woman of medium height with a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Prefers using old-school analog tools alongside modern digital software, often saying 'sometimes the best solutions are the simplest.'
